question: Can a candidate preserve research value and disclose loss, rather than merely export text?

scoring.successRule: Total >= 85; each core-research sample >= 75; each core-research documentValue >= 80; zero critical violations.

samples.layout: 12-page original Chinese single-column textbook with dense unique prose, running header/footer notes, cross-page table, formula, figure, references, and appendix

documentValueChecks.label: 正文、章节标题、跨页表、图、公式、参考文献和附录完整，不靠重复段落制造页数。
章与节形成连续阅读路径；表 1 的上半段和续页仍是同一个对象。
图、公式、参考文献、页码与对象区域能支撑研究者回到原页。
无法提取某类对象时，明确对象类型与范围，不把视觉内容伪成正文。

diagnosticAnchors.exactText: 1.1 研究型阅读的最小闭环
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: section 1.1 heading remains related to the body paragraphs on the same page
heading followed by its three body paragraphs in visual reading order, without interleaving the review callout or footer

diagnosticAnchors.exactText: 表 1 结构对象的研究后果（上）
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: table name, three columns, column headers, and upper-half data rows remain a table

diagnosticAnchors.exactText: 表 1（续）结构对象的研究后果
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: same table as zh-a3 with three columns, repeated header, and explicit continuation relationship

diagnosticAnchors.exactText: 图 1  四类解析对象的合成恢复概况
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: image resource, four labeled groups, caption, and body cross-reference remain linked

requiredText: 其中 T 为文字完整性，L 为定位质量，V 为视觉对象保留度。
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: formula and definitions of T, L, and V remain one inspectable equation object

requiredText: 这些情况不能被伪装成空白内容
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: heading and body preserve the rule that missing scan text is disclosed rather than reported as blank body text
four complete reference entries remain distinct, non-overlapping, and separate from the body and review callout

samples.layout: 13-page original Frontiers in Physiology article, copied unchanged; CC BY

documentValueChecks.label: Title、Abstract、正文、附录和 References 的范围完整，不跨栏拼句。
按视觉阅读顺序读取左右栏，图表跨栏时不打断章节逻辑。
图表、方程、附录表和文内引用均可回到页级对象。
无法恢复版式时明确标记双栏限制，不把交错文本报告为正常文章。

requiredText: Regularization provides an established framework to cope with this
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: title block and abstract paragraph remain distinct front matter before the first two-column INTRODUCTION section
pages 1 through 10 preserve left-then-right visual column order; cross-column figures and tables do not interrupt section continuity
Figure 1, its caption, and equations (2) through (5) keep separate object boundaries
Table 1 and equations (7) through (10) do not interleave with adjacent column body text
Figure 3 and equations (12) and (13) remain page-level objects with return paths
table caption, column headers, rows, and footnotes retain their column relationships
dense reference entries begin in a distinct region and preserve two-column reading order
Appendix Table A1 remains an appendix table with column relationships and is not merged into the reference section

samples.layout: 16-page NIST AI 100-1 benchmark derivative: 10 native source pages, two raster-only source pages, and four original derivative pages

documentValueChecks.label: 封面、来源声明、目录、原生正文/表图、附录和页映射作为同一报告完整保留。
目录、章节标题与页映射让读者能跨原生页、横向页和扫描页理解报告结构。
原生图表、长表、横向宽表与扫描页分别说明自己的页级和对象级复核范围。
第 6、12 页没有原生文字层；OCR 结果必须标明来源，不能伪装成原生精确文字。

diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: report title and benchmark-derivative identity are both visible on the cover

diagnosticAnchors.exactText: Tabassi, E. (2023), Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), NIST AI 100-1, National Institute of Standards and Technology, Gaithersburg, MD, https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.100-1.
requiredText: Republished courtesy of the National Institute of Standards and Technology.
This is not an official NIST publication
does not review, approve, or endorse
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: recommended citation and DOI are followed by the exact NIST courtesy line; modification date and nature and no-endorsement notice remain complete
original heading hierarchy and printed page-number relationships remain a table of contents
section heading, Figure 4, caption, and body remain separate but related objects

requiredText: Table 1: Categories and subcategories for the GOVERN function.
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: GOVERN body flows into the upper portion of Table 1 while preserving table rows and columns

diagnosticAnchors.ocrReferenceText: Mechanisms are in place to inventory AI systems
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: accurate OCR matching ocrReferenceText with disclosed OCR provenance may pass; image preserved plus explicit no-native-text disclosure without OCR remains pending between partial and failure

diagnosticAnchors.exactText: Table 2: Categories and subcategories for the MAP function.
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: current-page categories, subcategories, rows, and columns remain a table rather than scattered text
original landscape page, six columns, six rows, header, and row-column relationships remain intact

diagnosticAnchors.ocrReferenceText: AI Risk Management and Human-AI Interaction
diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: accurate OCR matching ocrReferenceText with disclosed OCR provenance may pass; image preserved plus explicit no-native-text disclosure without OCR remains pending between partial and failure

decisionDependency.question: If image-only pages are preserved and native-text absence is disclosed, but OCR is unavailable, is the result partial or failure?
decisionDependency.passCondition: Accurate OCR is returned with OCR provenance and uncertainty disclosed.
decisionDependency.unresolvedNoOcrCondition: Preserve the page image and disclose the missing native text; do not automatically mark pass.

samples.layout: 8-page original DOCX with real headings, numbering, merged cells, repeating long table, inline image/caption, OOXML footnote, and PAGE field

documentValueChecks.label: 段落、列表、表格、图片、脚注、页眉页码组成的内容完整。
Heading 1/2/3 和真实多级列表可用于顺序阅读。
图注、脚注、跨页表和页码能回到相应对象。
不支持嵌入对象时明确标明缺失，正文不被静默删去。

diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: title remains the cover title
Heading 1, Heading 2, and Heading 3 retain their semantic hierarchy
real Word numbering preserves two levels, sequence, and indentation
body footnote marker is linked to the note in word/footnotes.xml
matrix first row spans three columns while headers and data rows retain their grid
four columns and 32 unique records split across pages 4 and 5 with the header repeated on page 5
inline image, alternative text, and Caption remain related
running header and real PAGE field remain layout objects and do not pollute body text

documentValueChecks.label: 不凭空产生正文或摘要。
不把损坏字节伪装成可导航结构。
不产生看似可复核的页码或引用。
稳定返回 damaged_file / corrupt_pdf 专用失败分类。

diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: no fabricated body text or summary
no fabricated headings, table of contents, or chapters
no fabricated page, region, or object coordinates
stable repeatable damaged_file or corrupt_pdf; human-reviewable and no unrelated leakage

documentValueChecks.label: 未提供密码时不返回正文。
不因元数据猜测出一份可导航文档。
不产生未经解密的可复核引用。
稳定返回 password_required / encrypted_pdf 专用失败分类。

diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: no content before successful password authorization
no guessed title, chapter, or table
no fabricated page, region, or object locator
password_required or encrypted_pdf; fixture is AES-256-R5 and review password is collector-122

samples.layout: valid PDF padded to exactly 20 MiB + 1 byte

documentValueChecks.label: 大小校验失败后不产生正文。
不进入阅读结构或对象提取阶段。
不制造可复核的页内定位。
解析前返回 file_too_large，并报告 20 MiB 限制。

diagnosticAnchors.structureExpectation: exact input is 20971521 bytes and file_too_large occurs before parser invocation
no body, table, image, or equation output
no page, region, or object locator output
file_too_large reports actual 20971521 bytes and the 20 MiB limit
